scope: New live read-only source/schema audit. Not execution of iOS/Swift, not model accuracy validation, not a republication of legacy AUDITORIA.json metrics. CSV records use the exact observed response bytes and default TLS verification. ESPN documentation examples are third-party references; current live response evidence takes precedence.

espn_live_injuries.identity_warning: Injury id is report id. In this payload athlete.id is absent. Derive ESPN athlete id only from validated ESPN player links, then map roster espn_id to gsis_id; unresolved records must stay unresolved.

availability_conclusions.stats2026: Available now: HTTP 200, 4517 rows, weeks 1–5. Availability is limited to this consultation and may change.
availability_conclusions.injuries2026: Available now: HTTP 200, 1413 rows, weeks 1–5. Published weekly injury report is distinct from game-day participation confirmation.
availability_conclusions.historical_development_workflow: Real 2024 and 2025 stats plus 2025 roster were also downloaded. A season-2025 historical snapshot can be tested without manufacturing season-2026 data. Current-season sources are available, so no historical fallback is necessary merely for an assumed 404.
availability_conclusions.espn_network: Previously reported proxy blockage no longer applied during this audit: injuries, roster CHI, scoreboard 20261011, summary for last completed game, and news each returned HTTP 200. A draft change alone is not treated as evidence; these responses are runtime evidence.
availability_conclusions.provider_response_size: Live league injuries response is 8761015 bytes; a 5000000-byte response limit rejects the observed valid payload. Keep a bounded limit large enough for this measured payload.
availability_conclusions.source_freshness: Fetch time proves download time. Calendar/stat weeks and source report timestamps must be displayed separately; absent report does not confirm health or active game-day availability.

espn_schema_notes.injuries: Live top-level timestamp/status/season/injuries. Team groups have id/displayName/injuries; no team object at group level in this payload. Athlete has team and ESPN player links but no id.
espn_schema_notes.roster: Live top-level athletes array groups by position; each group has items array. Athletes have id/status. Roster Active is roster status, not confirmed game-day participation.
espn_schema_notes.scoreboard: Live events array, event status.type state/completed. Use explicit one-day dates; referenced third-party documentation warns date ranges returned 400 in its 2026-09-30 probe.
espn_schema_notes.summary: Live boxscore has teams and players sibling arrays. player statistic categories have athletes. First observed NFL athlete has athlete/stats without didNotPlay; missing flag means unknown, not active.
espn_schema_notes.docs_limit: Third-party response examples include NBA examples and historical shapes. They do not alone certify live NFL response format or pregame inactives.

validation_recommendations: Run the actual Swift core tests and HTTP/cache/scheduler tests; report executed test counts and failures separately from source downloads.
Use the live CSVs to exercise DataService mappings for current season and historical 2025, including duplicate keys, finite numeric metrics and game joins.
Validate each live ESPN schema and source timestamp; exercise missing athlete ID, unresolved GSIS mapping, cache freshness, provider outages and oversize responses.
Do not equate roster Active, an injury record absence, or a missing didNotPlay flag with confirmed game-day participation.
Run chronological model backtests in the implementation being shipped; compare to a fixed baseline and report sample selection, MAE and empirical interval coverage.
Do not certify the legacy 0.1 accuracy figures: this audit has not reproduced them or validated the changed 0.2 engine.
iOS UI compilation, simulator behavior and signing require macOS/Xcode; Linux core tests do not validate the SwiftUI app.
